text: Some specific external differences can be seen between cattle and buffalo. Horns are black and more developed in buffaloes. Buffalo skin is almost hairless and is dark grey to black in color. Buffalo hooves are splayed, compared to cattle hooves.
caveat: Source covers only a brief comparison of cattle vs. buffalo external features; a fuller external-anatomy description (as given for poultry and swine) is not present for cattle in this source.
